Print it at 5×7 inches for the classroom or send the share image straight to the group chat.

prompt:
Design a printable birthday party invitation card in portrait orientation, shown flat and front-on, filling the entire image edge to edge. It is the artwork itself, not a mockup: no table, no envelope, no hands, no drop shadow.
Theme: {{theme}}.
The card contains exactly the following text and nothing else, each item on its own line, spelled exactly as written:
"You're invited!"
"{{honoree}}"
[["{{age}}"]]
"{{date}}"
[["{{time}}"]]
"{{place}}"
[["{{rsvp}}"]]
The birthday person's name is the largest text. All text perfectly legible and well inside the card, with margins of at least 8% on every side so nothing is trimmed when printed. Print-quality detail.

faq.q: Can I print invitations at home?
faq.a: Yes. Print the 5×7 in JPG at actual size on card stock and trim along the edges. Two invitations fit on one 8.5×11 in sheet if you place them side by side in any photo printing app.

faq.q: What if a detail is misspelled?
faq.a: Generate again. Always proofread before printing or sending; each generation produces a fresh design.

faq.q: Can I use a photo of the birthday child?
faq.a: No. This maker designs illustrated invitations without photos, which keeps the text layout reliable.

faq.q: Can I change the "You're invited!" line?
faq.a: The opening line is fixed. Use the place or RSVP field for extra words, or add your own wording in an image editor after you download the card.
The printed card is 5×7 inches, and the print PDF adds a 0.125 inch bleed. The share image is 1080×1500 px for phones.

faq.q: How do I send it by text or WhatsApp?
faq.a: Download the share image and attach it like any photo. It is sized for phones, and the text stays readable on a small screen.

faq.q: Should I put the address on the invitation?
faq.a: For private invitations, include it. If the invitation will be posted in a public group, share the exact address only with guests who reply.

faq.q: Can I make an invitation for an adult birthday?
faq.a: Yes. Choose elegant black & gold, soft floral or watercolor splash, and write the milestone in the age field.

faq.q: How many invitations should I print?
faq.a: Print a few more than your guest list to cover late additions and mistakes. Small print runs are inexpensive at most print shops.
